clips.title: The story
paras: In Brill, A New Plague reaches its first test on a captive dwarf. Apothecary Johaan sends you to Gallows' End Tavern cellar with the brew he has made from reagents gathered across Tirisfal Glades.

Apothecary Johaan has brought his research to a dangerous trial. The Royal Apothecary Society works for Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, seeking a plague that kills the living while bypassing undead bodies. Johaan has brewed what he calls a “special drink” and sends you to give it to an imprisoned enemy of the Forsaken.

The Deathguard holds captives in a damp cellar beneath Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, where they await interrogation or disposal. One prisoner is a Dwarven Mountaineer, an Ironforge scout caught trespassing in Tirisfal Glades. Defiant and thirsty, he eagerly accepts the drink, unaware of what Johaan has mixed into it.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: According to the Deathguard, another one of those foolish Dwarven Mountaineers has just been captured. The Deathguard likes to use the cellar of the Gallows End Tavern as a holding cell until prisoners can be "properly" dealt with.
Why don't you go see how the Captured Mountaineer enjoys this special drink I made for him? It contains a subtle hint of what The Dark Lady has planned for the rest of Azeroth.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Why if I had my trusted rifle you'd be as good as dead, Adventurer. Just wait until the Steam Tank Brigade arrives to rescue me!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, a drink at last. I'm sure it's no Rhapsody Malt but I'll take anything to whet the old whistle at this point.
